title: test: massDeletionHeal's per-kind wipe rule has no case per branch, so dropping either the dirGone clause or the isWipe fraction branch leaves all 8 tests green
description:
This row follows up task-dfc05b72's QA review, which says: "Mutants: disabling the per-kind fraction branch, or the dirGone clause, alone survives, because (w) trips both ... Non-blocking follow-up: add one case per branch."

Evidence at HEAD 119fce99, packages/moe-daemon/src/state/massDeletionHeal.ts:94:
`if (!BOARD_KINDS.has(dir) && (dirGone || isWipe(lost, entries.size))) scan.wiped.push(dir);`
Here isWipe is `missing >= MASS_DELETION_MIN (3) && missing >= total * MASS_DELETION_FRACTION (0.2)`.

The repro ran in a scratch clone at 119fce99 (npm ci in packages/moe-daemon, then `npx vitest run src/state/massDeletionHeal.test.ts`). The suite gives 8/8 passed for all three variants:
- the shipped code;
- mutant A, `(isWipe(lost, entries.size))` with dirGone dropped;
- mutant B, `(dirGone)` with isWipe dropped.
Neither file has changed since 28df02f7 (task-dfc05b72).

QA's own probes give the two shapes that pin the branches:
- only the attempts and resources dirs deleted, each holding fewer than 3 entries, so only dirGone trips: the heal returns 2;
- 3 of 4 worker files deleted with the workers dir kept, so only isWipe trips: the heal returns 3.
Each case must stay under the combined rule's threshold, or that rule trips first.

This is a test-only row. The only file is packages/moe-daemon/src/state/massDeletionHeal.test.ts, and no open row's plan names it (checked at 119fce99).
definitionOfDone: massDeletionHeal.test.ts gains one case where a runtime kind's directory is deleted while it holds fewer than MASS_DELETION_MIN entries (only the dirGone clause can trip) and one where at least MASS_DELETION_MIN and MASS_DELETION_FRACTION of a kind's files are deleted with the directory kept (only isWipe can trip); each asserts the heal's return value and the restored files, and neither trips the combined rule.

In a scratch copy, replacing `(dirGone || isWipe(lost, entries.size))` with `(isWipe(lost, entries.size))` fails the first new case, and with `(dirGone)` fails the second; the shipped code passes both. The complete_task evidence quotes both mutant runs.
Only packages/moe-daemon/src/state/massDeletionHeal.test.ts changes, and its existing 8 cases are unchanged.
In a snapshot outside the shared checkout: cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/state/massDeletionHeal.test.ts exits 0.
